targets.records: Original event-log export/file/authoring/version/custody, the role-entry creation/update and surrounding dated shift/source record

targets.test: Determine whether this institutional role/endpoint was actually available for the identified conference, and whether its service was applicable. No identity reconstruction or contact attempt.

targets.test: Distinguish a contact listing and conference initiation from a successful joined session. Retain failed, negative and nonmatching evidence.

targets.records: Actual source distribution/receipt and nativeMay2003QFRknowledge/correction/delivery, signed consideration/action/no-action and distinct recommendation-disposition records
